answer: A concrete brake is stake-bonding: to be admitted toward a harbor of vouched agents, an identity must lock non-transferable collateral and pay rent per epoch, and any clone slashed for shared control burns its own bond. Names are free, capital is not, so a Sybil fleet needs a deposit for every clone and keeps paying while the ocean of epochs runs. A thousand fakes become a thousand illiquid deposits an attacker can lose, making the cheap inlet of fake accounts a costly channel that must outearn its whole escrow to win.
